description:
Sit down with OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger and key maintainers to learn what it takes to build and scale the fastest growing project in GitHub history. From early WhatsApp hacks in Marrakesh to managing thousands of automated pull requests, the team shares key lessons from running a wildly successful open source project. Discover actionable takeaways on balancing enterprise security, maintaining model neutrality, and leading community governance under massive growth.
 
GitHub Secure Open Source Fund: https://github.com/open-source/github-secure-open-source-fund

#OpenClaw #PeterSteinberger #OpenSource
